title: Declarations and freight movements
summary: This section explains the different ways goods can be declared to UK customs when being moved for international events.

title: Special procedures and reliefs for event goods
summary: This section provides guidance on how to handle goods being moved into the UK for international events, focusing on customs special procedures and reliefs, and where the goods are not being carried with the participant.

title: Roles and responsibilities
summary: This section sets out the roles of key parties involved in the movement of goods.

title: Commodity-specific requirements
summary: This section outlines special customs and regulatory requirements for specific types of goods frequently transported for international events.

title: Customs Import Duty reliefs
summary: This section explains customs duty reliefs for goods imported into Great Britain for events. It covers the main types of reliefs, eligibility, and claiming procedures including documentation, prior approval, and restrictions

title: Additional Procedure Codes for claiming reliefs when using the Customs Declaration Service
summary: Reliefs from import duties are available for selected imports into the UK. This section provides the ones most likely to be used however this may change depending on your individual circumstances.

title: UK legislation
summary: This section sets out the statutory framework and legislation governing duties and customs process.

title: Exporting goods to other countries from the UK for international events
summary: This section outlines the procedures and obligations for exporting goods from the United Kingdom for use at international events. It covers temporary and permanent exports, required documentation, customs procedures, and compliance with UK regulations.

title: Compliance checklists and templates
summary: This section includes a checklist for completing the C108 form with supporting documentation, steps for presenting goods at Great British borders, and requirements for retaining endorsed copies for audit.

title: Definitions
summary: This section outlines the various definitions of processes involved in moving goods for international events.

title: Importing goods to Great Britain for international events — passengers with accompanied baggage
summary: This section sets out the customs procedures to be followed by participants arriving in Great Britain with goods.

title: Contacts
summary: This section provides information on the various points of contact which have been provided to offer support.

title: Summary of customs procedures for event equipment
summary: This section provides a table of different types of equipment commonly imported or exported for international events such as sports competitions, concerts, exhibitions, and conferences, along with the corresponding customs procedures typically used for each category.

title: VAT treatment
summary: VAT treatment depends on supply conditions, including evidence of export, and whether Temporary Admission (TA) or other reliefs apply.

title: Customs checklist
summary: This checklist outlines the essential steps for managing import and export formalities effectively into the UK.

title: International events
summary: This handbook provides essential information for managing import and export procedures for international events. It outlines the key documents required and offers guidance on accompanied baggage, reliefs, licenses, and special procedures such as temporary admission.

title: Introduction
summary: This section provides information for managing import and export procedures for international events.

title: Statutory guidance: Income belonging to others  — statutory return (IBO-01)
summary: Use this template to send your IBO-01 return to HMRC if you receive a statutory notice for income belonging to others.

title: Guidance: Agent services account: service availability and issues
summary: Check the availability and any issues affecting the agent services account.

title: Guidance: Agent services account if you’re not based in the UK: service availability and issues
summary: Check the availability and any issues affecting the approval and set up of your agent services account if you are not based in the UK.
